title: Spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='topGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c81e3c'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='coneGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd93b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f1c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handle / stem -->
  <rect x='45' y='8' width='10' height='20' rx='4' fill='#7ee8fa'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='6' fill='#b8f6ff'/>
  <!-- upper body disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#ff8f8f'/>
  <path d='M16 36 Q50 50 84 36 L84 44 Q50 60 16 44 Z' fill='url(#topGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#ffc2c2'/>
  <!-- spinning stripes -->
  <path d='M30 35 Q50 41 70 35' stroke='#7ee8fa' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cone body -->
  <path d='M16 44 Q50 60 84 44 L50 82 Z' fill='url(#coneGrad)'/>
  <!-- cone highlight bands -->
  <path d='M34 55 Q50 63 66 55' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 68 Q50 72 58 68' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tip -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='4' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='1.8' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- motion sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#7ee8fa'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#7ee8fa'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#b8f6ff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#b8f6ff'/>
</svg>
